summary.tldr: Requires the Industry Minister to develop a national strategy to help establish food cooperatives in Canada and report it to Parliament.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Industry to develop a national strategy with measures to help establish food cooperatives in Canada.
Requires the minister to consult provincial governments, relevant stakeholders, and Indigenous community representatives when developing the strategy.
Sets out that the strategy is meant to help more small and medium-sized businesses compete in Canada’s grocery industry.
Requires the minister to prepare a report on the strategy within 18 months, table it in both Houses of Parliament, and publish it online.
summary.background: The bill says the strategy must be developed to facilitate the establishment of food cooperatives in Canada.
